title: The Shortcodes Ultimate plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Local File Inclusion in versions up to, and including,…
description: The Shortcodes Ultimate WordPress plugin up to version 7.9.1 contains a Local File Inclusion (LFI) vulnerability. This arises from unsafe handling of the Host header in URL construction and subsequent shortcode processing, allowing unauthenticated attackers to include arbitrary PHP files from the active theme's root directory. Additionally, if the 'Unsafe features' option is enabled, attackers can read arbitrary post meta data on any front-end page rendering the vulnerable shortcode.
